name: focusos-backend
description: Bun & Supabase PostgreSQL Backend for FocusOS Productivity Dashboard

scripts.start: bun run src/server.ts || ~/.bun/bin/bun run src/server.ts || npx tsx src/server.ts
scripts.dev: bun --watch src/server.ts || ~/.bun/bin/bun --watch src/server.ts || npx tsx watch src/server.ts
scripts.db:init: bun run src/init-db.ts || ~/.bun/bin/bun run src/init-db.ts || npx tsx src/init-db.ts
